original_test_intent: Verify that DCGM's CUDA main-library diagnostic path loads the approved CUDA/driver stack and that every applicable level-4 CUDA subtest completes without error.
original_method: Inventory GPU, driver, CUDA runtime/main library and DCGM builds plus actual linkage; preserve logs and baseline workloads, persistence, service and health; start DCGM in supported order; run one complete monitored level-4 diagnostic; map CUDA-specific subtests and error output; restore the approved runtime state.
manual_activity: CUDA platform owner approves the supported driver/runtime/DCGM combination and the CUDA-specific subtest oracle; lab operator owns isolation, service/persistence changes and abort response.
required_inputs: Approved driver, CUDA main library/runtime and DCGM versions
Actual CUDA library linkage and device enumeration
Runtime, temperature, power and error stop rules
safety_requirements: Preserve complete output and baseline logs
Never expose SSH credentials or disable host verification
Do not replace source level 4 with level 1
Monitor workloads, GPU and host during stress
Restore approved state; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Attribute CUDA subtests, failures and skips
Restore service/persistence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve stack and CUDA subtest acceptance matrix
Resolve service ordering and stop limits
